decisions.reason: As a small accessory with only stand-alone presentation and lower strategic importance than the trailer lines, it is the most likely to fall below aspirations and be discontinued so resources can be redirected.
Its repeated home-page placement suggests it met at least satisfactory aspiration levels and fits the firm's core trailer business, so boundedly rational management would continue it.

The car transporter trailer appears more niche and less prominently promoted, but after surviving several years without clear failure signals a medium-sized firm with some slack would more likely retain it while monitoring results.
The low-bed trailer series was prominently shown and is close to the firm's established competences, indicating performance likely at or above aspiration and low pressure to exit.
Consistent home-page visibility indicates acceptable market reception, and management would usually keep such a complementary series unless stronger evidence of underperformance emerges.
Although another box car trailer series may face internal comparison pressure, its prominent presentation and fit with the core product range make retention more likely than withdrawal.
